queue.descr: He Tryna Ignore It is a catchphrase most commonly associated with a reaction image of a white dog with its eyes closed sitting in front of a fire captioned, "he tryna ignore it 😭," and a screenshot of NBA super-fan Jimmy Goldstein watching LeBron James play basketball, featuring a comment from a user reading, "He tryna ignore it," suggesting James is trying to ignore Goldstein because of how perceivably creepy he looks. The dog reaction image was first uploaded online as early as January 2026, and the LeBron James meme was originally uploaded in late April 2026, going viral on TikTok shortly after. The dog meme spread over the following months, inspiring redraws, edits and image macros that recontextualize it.
